_comment: The production image of this repository and what it is made of (atrium-project#72 A.3).
Checked on every push by the hub's workflow-lint.reusable.yml (tools/ci/image_closure.py):
every first-party file the entrypoint can execute must be listed here or be a hub-canonical
shared component (docs/templates/shared/MANIFEST.json); a listed file it no longer reaches
fails too. Run it locally with: python ../atrium-project/tools/ci/image_closure.py
The pilot pins `-api`; `base` is the batch pipeline of the same stage (run_pipeline.py),
published, never pinned. The service runs run_pipeline.py, which runs api_*.sh, which run
api_util/*.py: the walk follows those script names too. Keywords and the LLM stage are
not part of this image since 1.0.0 (atrium-keyword-extract). api_flexiconv.sh is the
developer route (off the AMCR chain, nlp-enrich#10; flexiconv is a conditional GPL-3.0 component).
stage: morphology, named entities, TEITOK (LINDAT UDPipe and NameTag): POST /enrich, /enrich_text, /jobs, /rescale, /project_record
